registryAssessment: The official BPS statistical metadata record identifies Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Jepara as the 2025 PTSL activity organizer and provides its office contact; Jepara’s official JDIH also names the Kantor Pertanahan in local land-administration responsibilities. A locally branded BPN page describes an applicant-based plot-mapping workflow, but its legacy TIARRA article points to a Bandar Lampung host, so that endpoint is not treated as a verified Jepara public service. No anonymous vector layer or safe geometry response was found.

officialPrimarySources.observation: A Jepara land-office page identifies Kantor Pertanahan Jepara and describes a local TIARRA plot-mapping service for applications that requires account creation, supporting documents, and submission. Jepara’s official JDIH records also name the Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Jepara in local land administration. This establishes a local registry/mapping workflow, not anonymous open geometry.
Official supporting source reviewed; it does not provide a verified safe anonymous geometry response for the exact WUP point.
